items.name: animated-sliding-button
items.title: Animated Sliding Button
items.description: A pill button whose icon slides open into a staggered chevron trail on hover and focus. CSS-driven, fully keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: sliding-tab-on-hover
items.title: Sliding Tab On Hover
items.description: A pill nav whose lime indicator scales in, then slides to the hovered or focused tab. GSAP-driven, keyboard accessible, and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: avatar-reveal
items.title: Avatar Reveal
items.description: Overlapping avatars that pop in with an elastic blur, then the caption slides in from the right. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: auth-modal
items.title: Auth Modal
items.description: A sign-in dialog that fades the backdrop, then scales the panel in with staggered content. GSAP-driven and reduced-motion aware.

items.name: counter-number-on-scroll
items.title: Counter Number On Scroll
items.description: Digits that count up once when the number scrolls into view. GSAP ScrollTrigger plus Number Flow, and reduced-motion aware.
